page_title: LOR 4-1 LIL | Lorient v Lille 27/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Willy Delajod is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+2' A cross from a corner kick by Lille is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Lille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Lille have a corner.
90+1' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Angel Gomes (Lille).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top left corner. Yvon Mvogo is alert and denies him with a nice save. Lille force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Willy Delajod and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' A cross from a corner kick by Lorient is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
84' A substitution has been made. Ismaily is replaced by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille).
83' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
81' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) makes a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Remy Cabella (Lille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
77' Tiago Santos (Lille) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
76' Here is a change. Edon Zhegrova is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille).
76' Romain Faivre goes off the pitch and Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient) comes on.
76' The resulting set piece from Lille is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' The goal by Lorient won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
75' Wait! Referee Willy Delajod has indicated he is going to review the Lorient goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
75' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
74' Formose Mendy (Lorient) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
72' Tiago Santos (Lille) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
70' Formose Mendy (Lorient) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
67' 4 - 1 Goal! Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom right corner.
66' Lille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
62' 3 - 1 Goal! Romain Faivre (Lorient) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 3:1.
60' Pablo Pagis comes off the pitch to be replaced by Theo Le Bris (Lorient).
59' Regis Le Bris has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient) replacing Sirine Doucoure.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Julien Ponceau leaves the pitch and Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) comes on.
57' The booking goes to Sirine Doucoure (Lorient).
57' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' 2 - 1 Jonathan David (Lille) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
53' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ismaily (Lille).
51' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
49' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
47' The ball is cleared after Yusuf Yazici (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Willy Delajod blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
40' Paulo Fonseca decides to make a substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson will be replaced by Remy Cabella (Lille).
39' That's the end of the game for Ignacio Miramon, who is replaced by Angel Gomes (Lille).
39' None of the Lille players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
39' Leny Yoro (Lille) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
37' Ignacio Miramon (Lille) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yvon Mvogo.
35' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
33' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

30' Romain Faivre (Lorient) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Lucas Chevalier inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save.
30' Tiago Santos (Lille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bafode Diakite (Lille) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
25' Lorient failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
24' Lorient can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
22' Ignacio Miramon (Lille) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
15' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Leny Yoro (Lille) for his blatant foul.
14' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
10' 2 - 0 Goal! Sirine Doucoure produces a great pass that finds Julien Ponceau (Lorient) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the top left corner. 2:0.

9' 1 - 0 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Laurent Abergel (Lorient) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 1:0.
6' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
5' Lorient take a short corner kick.
5' Sirine Doucoure (Lorient) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out of play. Lorient are awarded a corner kick.
2' A quickly taken corner by Lorient.
2' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Lorient will take a corner kick.
2' Vincent Le Goff (Lorient) and Pablo Pagis combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lille will have the kick-off.
Willy Delajod will supervise the game today.
